<entry id="J00100">
<head-word>ידי, </head-word>
<head-word>יָדָה</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to point, move</italic> (cmp. b. h. הָדָה).</definition>
<notes>—Denom. יָד.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוֹדָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to raise hands</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to thank, acknowledge; to give praise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 6
<sup>b</sup> מוֹדִים … לך we offer thanks unto thee. Ber. V, 3 he who says in public prayer מודים מודים … אותו ‘we thank, we thank’ (as if pointing in different directions and acknowledging two divinities) must be silenced. Ib. IX, 5 (play on מ̇אד̇ך, Deut. VI, 5) בכל מ̇ד̇ה ומדה … הוי מוֹדֶה לו for whatever measure He metes out to thee, give thanks to Him. Ib. 54
<sup>b</sup> ארבעה צריכין להוֹרוֹת four persons are bound to offer public thanks; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to admit, consent, to confess</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. IV, 9 (56
<sup>a</sup>); Ber. 10
<sup>a</sup> על ג' הוֹדוּ לו concerning three of his acts they agreed with him. B. Mets. 3
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מוֹדֶה במקצת הטענה he who admits part of his opponent’s claim. Shebu. VI, 3; Keth. 108
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. טענו … וה' לו בשעורים, v. טָעַן I. B. Mets. 12
<sup>b</sup> בשחייב מודה when the debtor admits his indebtedness; a. v. fr. [Tosef. Par. IX (VIII), 6 שהן מודין, v. מוֹרִיר.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְיַדֶּה, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִתְוַדֶּה, (denom. of תּוֹדָה, cmp. Josh. VII, 19) 
<italic>to confess</italic> one’s sins before God. Yoma III, 8 ומִתְיַרֶּה and confesses in public. Ib. 40
<sup>a</sup> להגריל ולהִתְוַדּוֹת to cast lots and to make confession (on the head of the scapegoat). Y. ib. VIII, end, 45
<sup>c</sup> אע"פ שנ' בערבית צריך להתודות וכ' although he has made confession in the evening prayer, he must again confess &c.; a. fr.—V. וִידּוּי.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<head-word>יְדִי</head-word>

<sense>

<entry id="J00102">
<head-word>יָדִיד</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> redupl. of ידי; cmp. דּוֹד)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>pointed out</italic>,] 
<italic>chosen, beloved; chosen spot</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Men. 53
<sup>a</sup> יבא י' בן י' ויבנה י' … ויתכפרו בו ידידים the beloved (Solomon), son of the beloved (Abraham), shall rise and build a chosen structure (Temple) to the beloved (the Lord) in the lot of the beloved (Benjamin), that in it the chosen ones (Israel) be atoned for. Y. Ber. IX, 14
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Sabb. 137
<sup>b</sup> (benediction on circumcision) אשר קידש י' מבטן who sanctified the chosen one (Abraham, Is. XLI, 8; others: Isaac, with ref. to Gen. XXII, 2) from the womb.—
<plural-form>Pl. יְדִידִים,</plural-form> v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00103">
<head-word>יְדִידוּת</head-word>

<definition> preced.) 
<italic>choice; the chosen people</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. IX, 14
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Sabb. 137
<sup>b</sup> י' (זרע קודש) שארנו the chosen (of the holy seed) of our blood (race).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00104">
<head-word>יְדִיעָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (יָדַע) 
<italic>knowledge</italic>, esp. (Lev. IV, 14; 23; 28) 
<italic>finding out, discovery, consciousness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. 5
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. יְרִיעַת בית רבו שמה י' the knowledge acquired in the teacher’s house (a theoretical knowledge that one who touches an unclean thing becomes unclean &c.) is also called a knowledge (as regards the applicability of the verb נעלם). Ker. IV, 2 אם היתה י' בנתיים if there was consciousness between the two acts (if he found out his first transgression before committing the second). Shebu. I, 2 י' בתחלה וי' בסוף והעלם בנתיים original consciousness (knowing that he became unclean) and final consciousness (finding out that he had eaten sacred things in uncleanness) but forgetfulness between. Hor. 2
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. השב מִידִיעָתוֹ he who regrets when he finds out his transgression; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. יְדִיעוֹת</plural-form>. Sheb. I, 1 י' הטומאה the laws concerning the discovery of having sinned through uncleanness; ib. II, 1; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="J00106">
<head-word>יָדַע</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. יָדָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to point out, select, love</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to recognize, know; to find out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup> כיון שי' שחטא when he was convinced that he had done wrong. Ib. ואין אתה יוֹדֵעַ אם וכ' and thou knowest not whether &c. Ib. יודע הקב"ה את ישראל וכ' the Lord knows that Israel cannot endure the cruel persecutions of Rome (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Yalk. Hos. 529. Shebu. 4
<sup>b</sup>; ib. 5
<sup>a</sup> ונעלם מבלל שי' it says, ‘and it escaped his memory’ (Lev. V, 3)—this proves that there was a time when he knew (the nature of his act, v. יְדִיעָה). Zeb. 115
<sup>b</sup> דבר זה … ולא יְדָעוֹ וכ' this word (Ex. XXIX, 43) the Lord had said to Moses, but he did not understand it, until the sons of Aaron 
<pgbrk id="pg565" />died. Ib. כיון שי' … יְדוּעֵי מקום הן when Aaron learned that his sons were the chosen of the Lord (Lev. X, 3); a. v. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. יָדוּעַ a) 
<italic>chosen. </italic>
<plural-form>Pl. יְדוּעִים,</plural-form> constr. יְדוּעֵי, v. supra.—b) 
<italic>known, special, certain</italic>. Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, Par. 6, ch. VIII חטא י' a known (discovered) sin, v. יְדִיעָה. Y. Sot. I, 16
<sup>c</sup> טומאה יְדוּעָה (not ידוע) an ascertained levitical uncleanness, opp. ספק; a. fr.—בְּיָדוּעַ 
<italic>it is sure</italic>. R. Hash. 20
<sup>b</sup> בי' שנראה וכ' the moon must have been visible &c. Succ. 49
<sup>b</sup> כל אדם … בי' שהוא וכ' a popular man (v. חֵן) is, you may be sure, a God-fearing man; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (euphem.) 
<italic>to have sexual intercourse with</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 57
<sup>a</sup> בלא יְדָעָהּ when he never had connection with her. Esth. R. to III, 7 שלא יְדָעָהּ איש וכ' whom no man except her husband touched; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוֹדִיעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to make known, inform</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 22, beg. (ref. to Gen. IV, 1, reading יִדַּע for homiletical purposes) ה' דרך ארץ לכל he showed to all the way of the land (propagation, v. דֶּרֶךְ). Ḥull. V, 3 צריך להוֹדִיעַ must inform (the purchaser). Ab. IV, 22 לֵידַע להודיע ולהִוָּורַע to learn, to proclaim and to be made to feel (be thoroughly convinced). Sabb. 10
<sup>b</sup> צריך להוֹדִיעוֹ must inform him. Ib. לך והוֹדִיעֵם go and tell them. Ib. הנותן … צריך לה' לאמו he who gives bread to a child must inform his mother; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוֹדַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be informed, become conscious; to be made known.</italic></definition>
<notes> Shebu. I, 6 ה' ולא ה' whether he became conscious (of his transgression) or not. Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, ch. XX, Par. 12 (ref. to Lev. IV, 23; 28) את ה' שלהם when they become known; a. fr.—B. Bath. 113
<sup>b</sup> הוֹדְעָה Ms. M. (v. אָרַע II).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נוֹדַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Hor. III, 3. Ab. IV, 22, v. supra. Shebu. 9
<sup>b</sup> שסופו לִיוָּדַע of which he is likely to be informed. Ḥull. 9
<sup>a</sup> עד שיִוָּדַע לך, v. חֲזָקָה. Nidd. IX, 5, v. infra; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְוַודַּע, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִתְוַודַּע </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Bekh. 25
<sup>b</sup> עד שיִתְוַורַּע הטומאה (Nidd. l. c. עד שיודע לך וכ') until he ascertains the exact place of uncleanness; Pes. 10
<sup>a</sup> עד שתִּיוָּדַע לך Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. III, 6
<sup>b</sup> נתודע לו וכ' he found it out after sunset; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="unknown">מוֹדַע</xref>) 
<italic>to force one’s self upon the notice of, to pretend friendship for.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ab. I, 10 אל תִּתְוַדַּע לרשות do not make thyself a partisan of the (foreign) government.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="J00107">
<head-word>יְדַע</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>Targ. Gen. IV, 1; a. fr.—Ib. XXX, 26; a. fr:—Fut. יִדַּע, יִנְדַּע (fr. נדע). Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 5 אִידַּע Ms. (ed. אֵידַע). Targ. Ex. VIII, 6; a. fr.—Ber. 33
<sup>b</sup> אנא לא האי יְדַעְנָע I learned nothing either about this &c. Snh. 103
<sup>a</sup> (prov.—of one who derives no lesson from adversity or success) בכיי ליה למר ולא י' וכ' Ms. M. (ed. דלא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) they lament to you and you understand it not, they laugh to you and you understand it not; וי ליה למאן דלא י' וכ' (not למר) woe to him who knows not the difference between good and evil; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אוֹדַע, הוֹדַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> as preced. 
<italic>Hif.</italic> Targ. Ex. XXXIII, 13.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. CVI, 8 לאוֹדָעָה (Ms. לאַנְדָּ', v. supra); a. fr.—Snh. 11
<sup>b</sup> מְהוֹדְעִין אנחנא וכ' we (the Sanhedrin) notify you &c.; Y. ib. I, 18
<sup>d</sup> top מוֹדַעְנָא; Tosef. ib. II, 6 מְהוֹדַעְנָא (Var. מְהוֹדְעֵי אנחנא). Sabb. 33
<sup>b</sup> מאן לוֹדְעֵיה לבר וכ' (Ms. M. מוֹדְעֵיה) Oh, that some one would inform the son of Yoḥai &c. Ned. 62
<sup>a</sup> לאוֹדוּעֵי נפשיה to make one’s self known (as a scholar). Gen. R. s. 11 מנאן את מוֹדַע לי (some ed. מְיַדַּע) how will you prove it to me?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>יַדַּע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to III, 6 לינא מְיַדַּע לדין וכ' shall I not let him know with whom he is dealing?. Gen. R. s. 11, v. supra.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְיַדַּע 
<italic>friend</italic>. Targ. Ps. LXXXVIII, 9 מְיַדְּעַי Ms. (ed. מיודעי, hebraism).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְיְרַע, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְיַדַּע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be made known, to make one’s self known</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XLV, 1. Ib. XLI, 21; a. fr.—[Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 11 תתידעון, read: תיתרעון, as in v. 14.]—Hor. 2
<sup>a</sup> כי מִתְיַדַּע להו לבי דינא if the court were made aware of it. Sabb. 71
<sup>b</sup> א' ליה קודם וכ' he became aware of it before setting the sacrifice aside; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="J00114">
<head-word>יְהַב</head-word>
<language-key>(h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083">יָהַב)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to give</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. III, 12. Targ. Job III, 19 יֵיהַב Ms. (ed. יָהִיב, ed. Wil. יְהִיב); a. fr.—Part. pass. יְהִיב. Targ. Num. III, 9; a. fr.—Imperative הַב. Targ. Gen. XXX, 26; a. fr.—Y. Ber. VIII, 11

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>light, day</italic> (opp. night); (
<italic>astronomical</italic>) 
<italic>day;</italic> trnsf. 
<italic>day of life; time</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 6 הי' והגשמים וכ' the noise of the moving light (Yoma 20
<sup>b</sup> קול גלגל חמה) and the rains &c.; Midr. Sam. ch. IX. Gen. R. l. c. (ref. to Mal. III, 19) י' שהוא מלהט וכ' it is the day light which will glow the wicked (cmp. נַרְתֵּק). M. Kat. 25
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Am. VIII, 9) זה יוֹמוֹ של וכ' that means the day of life of Josiah (who was slain in the bloom of manhood). Gen. R. s. 3 (ref. to ib. I, 5) י' אחד … ואיזה זה יוה"כ ‘one (distinguished) day’ … that is the Day of Atonement. Ḥull. V, 5 (83
<sup>a</sup>) הי' הולך וכ' the day follows the night, i.e. the beginning of the night is the beginning of the new day. Taan. 29
<sup>a</sup>, v. זַכַּאי; a. v. fr.—י' טוב (abbr. יו"ט) 
<italic>Holy Day; festival</italic>. R. Hash. IV, 1; a. fr.—Yoma VII, 4 ויו"ט היה וכ' and the Highpriest gave a festival to his friends; a. fr.—
<italic>Yom Tob</italic>, name of a treatise of the Tosefta (v. בֵּיצָה).—י' הכפורים (abbr. יו"כ, יה"כ) Day of Atonement. Yoma I, 1; a. v. fr.—בֶּן יוֹמוֹ 
<italic>of the same day, not quite one day old, used on the same day</italic>. Sabb. 151
<sup>b</sup>. B. Kam. 65
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Kor. 3; ed. Bub. 6; Num. R. s. 18 תינוקות בְּנֵי יוֹמָן (not בן) children just born; a. fr.—
<italic>Du.</italic> יוֹמַיִם. Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 7; B. Kam. 90
<sup>a</sup> ישנו בדין יום או י' comes under the law of ‘one or two days’ (Ex. XXI, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>; B. Bath. 50
<sup>a</sup>.</definition>
<notes>—Mekh. l. c. יום שהוא כי' וי' שהוא כיום a time which counts like two days, and two days which count like a day, which is twenty four hours (from the time of the accident, including part of this and part of the next day).—Snh. 65
<sup>b</sup> מה יום מיומים (Ms. M. a. Rashi מה היום וכ') what difference is there between to-day (Sabbath) and the next day?; Gen. R. s. 11; Yalk. Deut. 918; Yalk. Lev. 617.—
<plural-form>Pl. יָמִים;</plural-form> constr. יְמֵי, יְמוֹת. Erub. III, 6 לשני י' for both days. Zeb. V, 7 לשני י' during two days and one night. Pes. 52
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. שני י' טובים של גליות, v. גָּלוּת. Taan. IV, 8 לא היו י' ט' וכ' Israel had no days as merry as &c.; a. fr.—Ab. I, 17, a. fr. כל יָמַי all my lifetime.—Esp. יְמוֹת 
<italic>season, period of</italic>. י' הגשמים, v. גֶּשֶׁם I.—י' החמה a) 
<italic>summer season.</italic> Toh. VI, 7; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>the solar year</italic>. Gen. R. s. 33, end; a. fr.—י' הלבנה 
<italic>the lunar year</italic>. Ib.; a. fr.—י' בגרות, י' נערות, v. בַּגְרוּת &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup> שמיוחד (v. infra); Yalk. Lev. 564.</definition>
<notes>—5) 
<italic>to leave persons alone in a special room, to arrange a private meeting for</italic>. Keth. 12
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. I, 4; Y. ib. I, 25
<sup>a</sup> bot. היו מְיַיחֲדִין וכ' they used to leave bride and groom in a private room alone for a while.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְיוּחָד, f. מְיוּחֶדֶת; pl. מְיוּחָדִים, מְיוּחָדִין, מְיוּחָדוֹת a)
